training_sources.name: UNDRR DesInventar Nepal
training_sources.training_use: 3,953 event-level flood records and impact labels from 1971 through 2013
limitations: Records are administrative event reports, not pixel-level flood maps.
Zero values can mean either no impact or incomplete reporting.

training_sources.name: Government of Nepal BIPAD Portal
training_sources.record_type: verified or approved flood incident records
training_sources.training_use: 1,396 event-level records and available impact labels from 2014 through 2023
limitations: Transport-loss values were uniformly zero in the imported records, so those labels are marked unknown instead of negative.
The import stops at 2023 to protect the locked 2024 holdout.

training_sources.name: NASA POWER Daily API
training_sources.training_use: 1-, 3-, 7-, and 30-day rainfall totals, rainy-day count, and rainfall anomaly
limitations: Daily gridded estimates are not river-gauge or street-level observations.
Weather enrichment is available from 1981 onward.

training_sources.name: Nepal National Statistics Office 2011 Census
limitations: A single census snapshot does not capture population changes over the full historical period.

training_sources.name: GADM 4.1 Nepal boundaries
limitations: District aliases are normalized so old and new spellings cannot land in different validation folds.

training_sources.name: Open-Meteo Elevation API
training_sources.training_use: district and location-level elevation and terrain-relief features
limitations: District samples summarize terrain and do not represent property-level elevation.

training_sources.name: HydroBASINS level 6 and HydroRIVERS
training_sources.training_use: basin area, upstream area, outlet distance, river proximity, long-term discharge, and river order
limitations: Level-6 catchments and global river reaches do not resolve every urban drainage channel.
Long-term average discharge is not event-time river stage or discharge.

reserved_holdout.rule: No 2024-or-later event or Nakkhu outcome label may be included in training, model selection, or threshold tuning.
